principle: Staffing is derived from capabilities, throughput and continuous coverage. Population categories remain separate.

micro_outpost.note: May be automated or run by a tiny crew.

major_complex.note: Exceptional; multiple sub-facilities and organizations likely.

starfleet_starbase_1_type.note: Use as large 2250s crew/community anchor, not universal starbase staffing.

federation_starbase_375_type.note: Capacity is not the same as duty staff.

derivation_rules: Determine 24/7 operational posts separately from day/peak staffing.
Business tenants staff their own businesses and do not count as Starfleet/operator duty staff unless separately assigned.
Docked ship crews remain members of their ships unless formally detached/transferred.
Transient visitors never fill station watch slots by default.
Patients/detainees are population load, not labor.
Large civilian populations increase medical/security/logistics/life-support demands but do not automatically increase command staff linearly.
Automation may reduce routine watch staffing but cannot eliminate required maintenance/emergency competence.
source_policy: Exact population figures remain unknown unless sourced; game-generated ranges are tagged GAME_ADDITION.
